owner: existing A-share daily KB producer; same security, source generation, prefix and indicator cache

kb_yidong_above_60d.definition: At >=65 bars, only after source volume ratio >=2 and pct_change>0, compare current close >= 0.95 times the unrounded mean of the latest 60 closes.
kb_yidong_above_60d.meaning: Current source position component, not an inferred pre-rise anchor. Source precondition false is NOT_APPLICABLE, not evidence of a false position.

kb_double_gun_vol1.source: complex_patterns.py::detect_double_gun, returned double_gun_vol1, same invocation as kb_double_gun

kb_double_gun_vol2.source: complex_patterns.py::detect_double_gun, returned double_gun_vol2, same invocation as kb_double_gun

kb_double_gun_gap_days.source: complex_patterns.py::detect_double_gun, returned double_gun_gap_days, same invocation as kb_double_gun

kb_bowl_upper.source: complex_patterns.py::detect_golden_bowl, source white line, rounded to 2 decimals

kb_bowl_lower.source: complex_patterns.py::detect_golden_bowl, source yellow line, rounded to 2 decimals

kb_violence_k_body.source: key_candles.py::detect_violence_k, latest event body_pct, source rounded to 1 decimal

source_behavior.double_gun: Use the source result already computed for kb_double_gun. Its volume ratios/gap are meaningful only for an observed hit; non-hit is NOT_APPLICABLE with null components, never source defaults of zero. The existing owner guards 24 bars even though the source helper itself has a 15-bar early return.
source_behavior.bowl: Read the same cached white/yellow source lines as kb_in_bowl, at >=120 bars with a valid close prefix. The source returns both lines even without a bowl hit and calls them upper/lower even if their numerical order is inverted.
source_behavior.violence: Use the same list already computed for kb_violence_k and require exactly one is_latest source event on a hit. On known non-hit, type/body are NOT_APPLICABLE; never turn absent type or body into a zero. The existing owner guards 21 bars even though the source helper starts at 10.
source_behavior.source_identity: Local helper code/contract have their own hashes. Do not assign the upstream source-file SHA as the hash of the modified local rule or certify source strategy validity.

status_semantics: Each component group retains status and required/available bars. INSUFFICIENT_HISTORY, INVALID_OR_UNBOUND_INPUT and NOT_APPLICABLE are distinct; None is never replaced by zero or False.
incremental: On the first authorized two-stock field bootstrap evaluate the missing fields from already-bound daily prefixes; then compute newly added rows, newly matured rows after earlier history is restored, and only dates affected by actual input revisions. Persist rule and input/calendar/price-basis identities; do not add a producer, timer, unrelated full-history recalculation, or future data.
excluded: Source two-30% return conflates a price-only proxy with the separate turnover requirement; B1 anchor and turnover acceptance are not settled. Six-phase anomaly anchors and thresholds also remain separate pending rules.
